top.line: One Human, Nine Agents, Nineteen Hours is on Leanpub: free as a minimum, 19 dollars suggested, updated as it goes.
top.para: The day nine AI agents and I built a talk in nineteen hours, told as a factory: who did what, the five steps, the stop file, what did not work, and then how to build yours. 90% complete, published early for feedback.

in-short.line: The book is out, what it is, the price, and its state.

about.line: 29 October 2026: an empty project, a brief, one page of rules, nine agents, a talk nineteen hours later.
about.para: Five steps on every turn, a file that could stop everything, what did not work; then one agent, one page of rules, one brief, one finished piece of work.

made.line: Written by agents for one human, every number traced, through two release candidates, a cold read, a lab and newsroom reviews.
made.para: Two A4 review copies printed in early November.

why.line: Leanpub publishes while writing and gives every reader every update.
why.para: The last 10% is where feedback matters most.

limits.line: 90% complete; the listed format is PDF.
